entries.sentinel: IMPLEMENTED_NOT_LIVE: ER-08/ER-13 versioned Investigation ledger over D1 with CAS-coupled batches, authority-conditioned writes and explicit supersession; Workflow/Session composition and live receipts remain separate.
entries.behavior: Versioned Investigation ledger heads plus append-only events over D1 Core migration 0014 (sole schema authority; no embedded DDL). Append couples a revision-conditioned event insert with an authority-conditioned CAS (revision plus principal/scope/policy/deployment refs) and exact readback. Supersession runs CAS-first with every later effect chained to this batch's own CAS output: the SUPERSEDED mark requires our status plus reason, the replacement head requires our mark event id, the replacement event requires our new head; a stale or foreign old head therefore yields zero effects and never an orphan replacement beside a live old head. Batch errors roll back via the D1 batch transaction; zero-change CAS loss is reported as LEDGER_STALE_HEAD only after direct row inspection confirms no partial effect. Fence snapshots are re-fetched immediately before each D1 write and any provider drift denies with zero D1 effect; committed CAS effects are additionally conditional on the D1 head still carrying the fence-checked authority refs. Exact replay returns the prior effect with no second mutation (store-level for append and supersede, service-level lineage reconciliation for supersede); any divergent byte under a reused event id is LEDGER_CONFLICT with no effect. Fail-closed portfolio verification, named-verifier acceptance binding, and deviated-obligations-only-via-supersession retained. Precise blockers: purge has no ledger column so provider rotation between the last fence check and batch commit is a residual race, not a proven-closed window; Workflow/Session composition, research.run enablement and remote D1/Queue/live qualification NOT_EXECUTED.
